translations.Quick Booking adds a public booking page:
Quick Booking adds a public booking page for the appointment schedules you already have in the Calendar app. Requires the Calendar app.

Visitors pick a date and time, enter their details, review and confirm on the same page. The appointment is booked immediately and the usual booking confirmation email (with .ics) is sent.

* Share the usual Calendar booking link ("Copy link" in the Calendar app): it opens Quick Booking.
* One-time appointment schedules: offer appointments on one or more chosen dates (e.g. parent-teacher conferences) instead of weekly. Create them in the Calendar app under "One-time appointment schedules".
* Built-in rate limiting of bookings per visitor and per email address.
* Self-check: verifies after every Calendar or Nextcloud update that it still works, and lets the booking link show the standard Calendar booking page when something breaks.
translations.Please enable JavaScript to book an appo: Please enable JavaScript to book an appointment.
translations.Quick Booking uses internal code of the: Quick Booking uses internal code of the Calendar app. It checks after every Calendar or Nextcloud update and once a day that this still works. If something breaks, visitors are sent to the standard Calendar booking page and admins get a notification. While switched off, the check repeats every 15 minutes and switches back on when it passes.
translations.Off: visitors use the standard Calendar: Off: visitors use the standard Calendar booking page.
translations.Bookings from several different networks: Bookings from several different networks failed while the self-check passed. Quick Booking switches back on after a Calendar update, or when you run the check below and it passes.
On: visitors book through Quick Booking.
translations.This is a private address. That is fine: This is a private address. That is fine if you are on the same network as the server. If you opened this page from outside (for example a phone on mobile data), Nextcloud does not know your reverse proxy: all visitors then share one address, and the booking limit applies to all of them together. Add the proxy to "trusted_proxies" in config.php.
translations.This should be the public address of the: This should be the public address of the device you are using right now. If it is the address of your server or proxy instead, add the proxy to "trusted_proxies" in config.php.
translations.Share the Calendar's own booking links (: Share the Calendar's own booking links ("Copy link" in the Calendar app). They open Quick Booking while it is on, and the Calendar booking page while it is off, disabled or removed. Links to /apps/quickbook/book/… only work while the app is installed.
